Change Scenario: Adding multiple delivery partners with different assignment rules
Current Design: Order has a single delivery_person ForeignKey, and adminassignordertodelivery() directly retrieves and assigns a DeliveryPerson
Proposed Change: Extract delivery-partner selection into interchangeable strategies for different assignment rules
Expected Benefit: New delivery-partner assignment rules can be added with less change to the main assignment logic

Change Scenario: Adding new order-status notification recipients or behavior
Current Design: adminupdateorderstatus() updates the order status and publishes events through Channels groups for Admin, Restaurant and Delivery consumers
Proposed Change: Separate status changes from notification/event handling and allow additional observers or notification handlers to respond to the order-status event
Expected Benefit: New notification recipients or behaviors can be added with less coupling to order-status processing

Change Scenario: Changing the delivery-partner selection rule without modifying the main assignment logic
Current Design: adminassignordertodelivery() directly retrieves and assigns a DeliveryPerson
Proposed Change: Use a Strategy abstraction so the assignment context can select a different delivery-partner selection rule
Expected Benefit: Assignment rules can be changed independently without rewriting the main assignment flow
